Subject: Re: [ILUG] Mounting Windows shares in Linux

Stephen Burke wrote:
> A further question: Is it possible to list/see all shares on a windows 
> server?
> I.E., Id like to be able to browse //servername/  to see all its 
> available shares from linux.
Yes. I can see the all the Windows shares on Ubuntu, even when I don't 
have permission to open them. Browsing //  does  work, in 
some file browsers

You don't see ones prefixed by $, but if you have permission you can 
connect to them.
>
> Cheers,
> Steve Burke


-- 
Mike
